english.title: Furnish false or misleading information to Natural Resources Wales re packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) furnished information that was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), to Natural Resources Wales in connection with a function under the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023, knowing or being reckless as to whether the information was false or misleading in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(4) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
